jobs.description: Image mark International Recruiter | Staphorst  Locatie Staphorst  Werktijden 24 - 40 uur Do you get energy from finding the right people for the right job? Do you enjoy connecting with candidates, have strong communication skills, and know how to reach talent through various channels? Then we have a great opportunity for you. You will guide them throughout the entire recruitment process. Wat ga je doen? As an International Recruiter, you will be responsible for recruiting and selecting candidates. On a daily basis, you will be in contact with job seekers. Your responsibilities include: - Managing the entire recruitment and selection process for international candidates - Actively sourcing candidates through job boards, social media, and other recruitment channels - Creating and managing online recruitment campaigns - Conducting telephone screening interviews and job interviews - Matching candidates with vacancies in the metal, engineering, production, logistics, and construction sectors - Handing over suitable candidates to our coördinators - Maintaining and expanding the candidate database - Processing recruitment-related administrative tasks Wat bieden we jou? As an electrical test technician, you will work full-time at a modern high-tech company in Eindhoven. You will be responsible for testing and inspecting cables, electrical modules, and smaller control cabinets. You will ensure that all products function correctly and safely before they are delivered to customers. You will work day shifts in a clean, well-organized environment where quality and precision are essential.You will independently carry out various testing activities based on technical drawings, electrical diagrams, and test procedures. You will prepare test setups and perform safety, functional, and visual inspections. During these tests, you will check whether products meet the required quality standards and technical specifications.When you identify defects or a​bnormalities, you will investigate their causes and carry out repairs when necessary. You will document your findings and discuss them with colleagues from the assembly department. You will also examine products returned by customers to determine the causes of any defects.You will actively contribute ideas to improve testing and production processes. With your technical knowledge and attention to detail, you will play an important role in maintaining product quality. You will also have opportunities to further develop your skills through training and courses.Are you technically skilled, analytical, and someone who enjoys solving problems?
